subject: english
question:
Identify the error in the sentence.

He always is arriving late to meetings.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The placement of the adverb "**always**" is incorrect in the sentence.
 
• Adverbs like "**always**" typically go after the auxiliary verb in sentences with continuous tenses.
 
• The correct placement should be "**is always arriving**," ensuring grammatical accuracy.
 
• Thus, the error lies in **part A** of the sentence ("always is").

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He is always arriving late to meetings."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **B: "is arriving" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **C: "late to"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **D: "to meetings"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
